posts.author: Sinacs
posts.body:
Hello. I actually joined the forum last year, but this is my very first post.(virtually, I guess...)
I first got into RPG Maker around 2008-2009 after being deeply inspired by
Ao Oni
.
My current engine of choice is RPG Maker MV. I have released two titles on Steam: a relay game developed as a team effort titled
"Grievous Survivors"
, and a personal project titled
"Monsters and Sprites"
.
It's great to finally introduce myself, and I look forward to being a part of this community.
(a little bit of gemini used because my English is ENGRISH)
